notes.title: Meet the Nine!
notes.notes: [p]Hello again! [/p][p][/p][p]Jamie here, Director of Kittens in Timespace and Lead Designer on CLAWPUNK.[/p][p][/p][p]Today, we’re introducing the stars of the game, the CLAWPUNKS themselves. These are the playable felines you’ll get to know as you crash your way through Feral City. We’re going to check out their play styles, strengths and weaknesses, and find out what makes them tick. [/p][p align="center"][/p][h2]Dash[/h2][p]The natural leader of the gang. Built for speed and agility, his Rage Dash ability destroys anything in his path faster than you can say MEOW![/p][p][b]Attack:[/b] 1/10[/p][p][b]Speed:[/b] 5/5[/p][p][b]Playstyle: [/b]Fast, agile. Perfect for players new to CLAWPUNK.[/p][p][b]Weapon:[/b] Prototype Laser Sword[/p][p][b]Cat Fact:[/b] Cannot go a day without a burst of energy from Catnip Pop![/p][p align="center"][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45036736/dd4bf4c649b1388ab70821c7f4fd58e7faa1d89d.jpg"][/img][/p][h2]Buck[/h2][p]A one-cat wrecking crew and ex-circus strong-cat. Has a thick Scottish accent, thicker fur and an even thicker skull. While slower than most other cats, Buck hits a LOT harder. [/p][p][/p][p][b]Attack:[/b] 10/10[/p][p][b]Speed:[/b] 1/5[/p][p][b]Playstyle: [/b]Slow, area of effect. Devastating attack power.[/p][p][b]Weapon: [/b]The KITTY HAMMER![/p][p][b]Cat Fact: [/b]Collects teddy bears in his free time.[/p][p align="center"][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45036736/8e8b01bec309117bec462057c3f6054c6beeb14b.jpg"][/img][/p][h2]Candy[/h2][p]To Candy, fighting is a performance. Terrifyingly precise, she acts as the gang’s tactician. Always has a plan and a sly smile to match.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Attack:[/b] 5/10[/p][p][b]Speed:[/b] 2/5[/p][p][b]Playstyle: [/b]Medium speed, very precise. Has the longest attack range.[/p][p][b]Weapon:[/b] Chain Whip[/p][p][b]Cat Fact:[/b] Once engaged to her school sweetheart, who went on to join the K9 units.[/p][p align="center"][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45036736/cd97ed59d79e91ff3684b851f2f4dc07d4deee91.jpg"][/img][/p][h2]Banshee[/h2][p]Stalking the city like a ghost, Banshee’s past is a mystery. She fights with flair, fury and an unhinged scream that echoes long after her blades stop spinning.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Attack:[/b] 6/10[/p][p][b]Speed:[/b] 3/5[/p][p][b]Playstyle:[/b] Ranged, projectile-based weapon.[/p][p][b]Weapon:[/b] Scythe guitar[/p][p][b]Cat Fact: [/b]Banshee’s goth band broke up after her screaming during rehearsals destroyed the equipment at a prestigious music festival.[/p][p align="center"][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45036736/be815768ee03fcecebd495314d0ba20bc14af28b.jpg"][/img][/p][h2]Haxx[/h2][p]More machine than feline, Haxx’s heart still beats pure punk. Insanely smart, Haxx treat combat like code: if it works well, it can be weaponised.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Attack:[/b] 3/10[/p][p][b]Speed:[/b] 3/5[/p][p][b]Playstyle: [/b]Medium-pace, Flying.[/p][p][b]Weapon: [/b]Wheelchair Whirlwind[/p][p][b]Cat Fact:[/b] Once hacked a vending machine in Barbara’s arena to produce only live grenades.[/p][p][/p][p align="center"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45036736/cf50b0539097247e2d30abb39b22288289bcb9ab.jpg"][/img][/p][h2]Benny[/h2][p]A master engineer with roots in farm life. Re-built himself from scratch, LITERALLY, after losing his arms in a devastating accident. [/p][p][/p][p][b]Attack:[/b] 8/10[/p][p][b]Speed:[/b] 2/5[/p][p][b]Playstyle: [/b]Slow, rapid-fire attacks.[/p][p][b]Weapon:[/b] Metal fists[/p][p][b]Cat Fact:[/b] Survived a ten-storey fall by landing on his own crate of handmade fireworks[/p][p align="center"][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45036736/7152f05f34d3a95377379ae1e726e61e76574d5f.jpg"][/img][/p][h2]Jenny[/h2][p]The quiet storm of the crew, Jenny is cool under pressure and deadly up close. She slices with the precision of a master chef and the madness of a butcher![/p][p][/p][p][b]Attack:[/b] 7/10[/p][p][b]Speed:[/b] 2/5[/p][p][b]Playstyle: [/b]Ferocious, continuous attack style.[/p][p][b]Weapon: [/b]Chainsaw[/p][p][b]Cat Fact: [/b]Once accidentally sawed a tank in half.[/p][p align="center"][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45036736/3977c65ee034724d50f02f88c4bb6f314bc6a484.jpg"][/img][/p][h2]Jynx[/h2][p]Jynx is elusive, enigmatic and not entirely bound by this reality. He appears when he is needed and disappears when bored. Rumours have it he speaks to spirits in his sleep.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Attack:[/b] 4/10[/p][p][b]Speed:[/b] 4/5[/p][p][b]Playstyle: [/b]Floaty, continuous damage.[/p][p][b]Weapon: [/b]Psychic Orbs[/p][p][b]Cat Fact: [/b]Has never been seen blinking.[/p][p align="center"][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45036736/46a37535804b6c52f4037a9847518f63b14339a8.jpg"][/img][/p][h2]Larry[/h2][p]Claims to be a war hero, part-time treasure hunter...and mayor of a town that does not exist. The only thing in life which brings Larry joy without exploding is the beloved pogo stick he received as a kitten.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Attack:[/b] 1/10[/p][p][b]Speed:[/b] 1/5[/p][p][b]Playstyle: [/b]Literal wildcard cat, you either like him or you don’t.[/p][p][b]Weapon: [/b]Triggered Explosive[/p][p][b]Cat Fact: [/b]Gained a love of explosions after enjoying a fireworks show from INSIDE the launch site.[/p][p align="center"][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45036736/d9c100ef1fab676d73bb08936238db133cf8cb05.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Fancy seeing each cat in action? You can watch our recent devlog video below![/p][previewyoutube="e_QeaWLOF-c;full"][/previewyoutube][p]That’s all for today! Thank you for checking out this devlog. Stay tuned for more updates every month. We’ll dive into the different parts of the game in much more detail. [/p][p][/p][p]Also, in case you missed it - CLAWPUNK is going to be part of the [url="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=2AD-WSCyvK8"]PC Gaming Show[/url] Tokyo Direct Showcase, Sunday 28th September! We hope to see you there![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45036736/42a1e06f878bc3b800794c7162f7fbd12137b16a.png"][/img][/p][p]In the meantime, we’d love it if you checked us out on social media and joined our [url="https://discord.gg/cW46qDgT2K"][u]Discord[/u][/url] channel to talk more CLAWPUNK![/p][p][/p][p][b][i]~ Kittens in Timespace[/i][/b][/p]

notes.title: Welcome to the Chaos!
notes.notes: [p]Are you a curious cat or hardcore action fan sniffing out your next favourite indie game? Either way, we're inviting you to the world of CLAWPUNK! This 2D action game is infused to its core with relentless feline-related chaos. [/p][p][/p][p]My name is Jamie, I'm the Lead Designer and Director of [url="https://kittensintimespace.com/"]Kittens in Timespace[/url]. I am THRILLED to be sharing a behind-the-scenes peek into the development of our latest passion project.[/p][p][/p][h2][b]WHAT IS CLAWPUNK?[/b][/h2][p]At its heart, CLAWPUNK is a melee-focused 2D action game starring an array of badass cat characters. You'll tear through a fully destructible environment, where every smash and bash rewards an aggressive play style. Aim for the highest score possible by laying to waste everything in your path![/p][p][/p][p]Today, we'll scratch the surface of the gameplay, reveal some lore, and introduce you to a few members of the squad.[/p][p][/p][h2][b]SCRATCH, SMASH, SURVIVE![/b][/h2][p]CLAWPUNK is best described as an arcade-inspired action game. Every run drops you into a destructible playground where players are encouraged to cause as much carnage as possible. More powerful attacks are offered to those who take risks by charging right into the fray. You’ll smash your way through tons of enemies, defeat powerful bosses, and rip up the environment like a true menace.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45036736/0c4785f8d3f6e679cc2d578282b247d80d267475.jpg"][/img][/p][p]The game leverages a fast-paced loop:[/p][p][/p][olist][*][p]Dive straight into the chaos with [b]melee combat, guns, and clever positionin[/b]g.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Destroy[/b] your surroundings.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Collect and equip cards[/b] to enhance your cats with new abilities and effects (so, [i]so[/i], much more on this later!).[/p][/*][/olist][p][/p][p]Each playable cat has a unique rage ability, stat distribution, and the card system will allow you to bend the rules to make the cats your own. Upgrade your loadout in the Hub Stage and prepare for even more frantic encounters.[/p][p][/p][p]Each zone is a new opportunity to test your reflexes and try out a different playstyle. Thanks to the game’s persistent card system, you can tailor your loadout to your favourite tactics, whether that’s dishing out brutal area damage or executing surgical strikes with finesse. You can expect boss fights that push your builds to the limit, breakable arenas that reward creative play, and loads of feedback that makes every swipe feel satisfying.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45036736/cf5c2b9d706ffe93bd8741238fbc2515090c8e79.jpg"][/img][/p][h2][b]INSPIRATIONS[/b][/h2][p]CLAWPUNK draws inspiration from many games and genres. This includes Hotline Miami, Hades, Katana ZERO, and even Super Smash Bros. if you squint a little. We’re big fans of games that feel punchy, reactive, and built for experimentation. We’re channelling all that energy into CLAWPUNK with a twist.[/p][p][/p][h2][b]LORE[/b][/h2][p]There's much more on this to come, but for now, here’s a some backstory to set the scene...[/p][p][/p][p]CLAWPUNK takes place in a post-collapse metropolis called Feral City. Inspired by a dystopian London, it is a place torn apart by gang war, corruption, and an oppressive regime. Amidst the ruins, factions rise and fall…but from the shadows, a resistance is growing.[/p][p][/p][p]You play as part of a gang of street-punk feline fighters, each with their baggage, backstory, and combat style. They’re not just fighting for survival; they're fighting for revolution underpinned by mystery and betrayal. There will be nine playable cat characters, and each one brings their flavour to the fight. Some are driven by personal vendettas, others by loyalty, greed, or just the thrill of the fight. The full line-up reveal will come in a future devlog.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45036736/24a9fee80cf392486ddf256e93cbc7d275fa07e6.jpg"][/img][/p][h2][b]THAT'S A WRAP![/b][/h2][p]I hope to share more devlogs every month with deeper dives into combat, level design, characters, art style, and more. If this sounds like your kind of chaos, we’d love for you to join the Kittens and Megabit community! Please, follow us on social media, jump into our Discord, and spread the word. [/p][p][/p][p]Stay Clawsome![/p][p][/p][p][i]– Jamie, Director, Kittens in Timespace[/i][/p][p][/p][p][url="https://discord.gg/xd3dnxUDR5"]Discord[/url] | [url="https://x.com/megabitpublish"]Twitter[/url] | [url="https://www.facebook.com/megabitpublishing/"]Facebook[/url] | [url="https://bsky.app/profile/megabitpublishing.bsky.social"]Bluesky[/url] | [url="https://www.tiktok.com/@megabitpublishing"]TikTok[/url] | [url="https://www.instagram.com/megabitpublishing/"]Instagram[/url] | [url="https://www.youtube.com/@megabit-publishing"]YouTube[/url] [/p]
